Update the phase status file and the quartermaster README to reflect the closed round. Extend the band record with the round-5 disposition and append the newly reviewed round-3 findings write-up. Correct the existing round-2 review note where it has gone stale. Add the outstanding early-exercise report entry so the exercise ledger matches what actually ran. Keep every edit confined to records and status prose — do not touch any executable or configuration file, and do not reopen findings that round 4 already closed.
claims: We committed the round-4 delta verdict and closed round 5 as a records-only pass touching six files: the phase status file, the quartermaster README, the band record, an early-exercise report, and two round-review notes, for 82 insertions and 6 deletions.
